'''Camp Shadow''' was a [[Balmorran resistance]] base in the [[Moraine Gulch]], a region of the [[Gorinth Canyon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. During the final days of [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|fighting]] on Balmorra during the [[Galactic War]], Imperial forces overran the camp, forcing [[Taya Rinn]] and the rest of the resistance members there to flee to [[Moraine Outpost]]. Rinn later recruited Republic help in retrieving resistance data from the camp's computers.
